region.name: Alabama
region.definition: A record is in when NPS's State field (eye's details.state) puts it in Alabama and its point lies inside, or within 0.05 degrees of, eye's outline state:01 from https://eye.jcamd.com/api/economy?op=areas&level=state (Census TIGERweb, generalised 1:20M; response sha256 e43aaa9eecb50a923507578c16309b9b8199b158ed84e138bbb419c654ddbaa3, retrieved 2026-10-18T23:06:58.575Z). The tolerance covers the generalised coast and river borders; the source's own state field decides between neighbours. bbox is the widened outline's extent. Records came from 1025 requests to eye's land?op=historic: 0.12-degree boxes on eye's 0.02-degree grid that touch the widened outline, each split in four while eye said truncated (0 split), deduplicated by id.

sources.licence: US federal (public domain); general reference only, not Section 106 compliance; NPS publishes only non-sensitive, non-restricted listings

publisherCount.method: ArcGIS REST query on the publisher's own layer: where State='ALABAMA', returnCountOnly=true (keyless). Every row the publisher files under Alabama, whatever its status.
publisherCount.gap: The publisher counts 919; this snapshot holds 913. 5 left out by this snapshot's region rule: the source says Alabama but the point lies more than 0.05 degrees outside eye's outline: nrhp:pt:1465072, nrhp:pt:1470393, nrhp:pt:1479934, nrhp:pt:1479945, nrhp:pt:1479949; 1 NPS STATUS Removed: not a current listing, and eye asks only STATUS='Listed': nrhp:pt:1465754. Not counted either way: 226 feature(s) from edge tiles whose source names another state.

withheldFields.why: NPS's RESNAME can be a person's name (eye's nrhp-listed card: never searched or embedded); a training snapshot leaves it out
